meta.title: Data Dictionary — Summit Supply Co.
meta.generated_from: Live profile of the SQLite database merged with knowledge_base/semantic_layer.yaml.
meta.domain: Summit Supply Co. is a US omnichannel retailer selling electronics, computers, office supplies, furniture, home & kitchen, sports, books and health products to consumers and businesses. The database covers customers, orders and order lines, the product catalog, and the workforce.

conventions.rule: Dates are ISO-8601 TEXT 'YYYY-MM-DD' with no time part. Compare them with string literals (OrderDate >= '2024-01-01'), bucket with strftime('%Y', col) / strftime('%Y-%m', col), and compute day differences with julianday(a) - julianday(b).
The data is a snapshot as of 2026-10-20. Resolve relative periods ("last month", "this year", "last 90 days") against '2026-10-20' — e.g. date('2026-10-20', '-90 days') — not date('now').
The fiscal year is the calendar year; quarters are calendar quarters (Q1 = Jan–Mar).
State columns (Customers.State, Employees.State, Orders.ShipState) hold 2-letter USPS codes such as 'CA' or 'NY', never full names. "California" must become 'CA'.

"Revenue" / "sales" means net revenue: SUM(OrderItems.Quantity * OrderItems.UnitPrice * (1 - OrderItems.Discount)) over orders whose Status is not 'Cancelled' or 'Returned', excluding shipping — unless the user explicitly asks to include those.
OrderItems.UnitPrice is the price charged at the time of sale; Products.UnitPrice is today's list price. Always use OrderItems.UnitPrice for sales figures.
Orders has no total column. An order's value is the sum of its lines (Quantity * UnitPrice * (1 - Discount)); add Orders.ShippingCost only when asked for the amount billed.
OrderItems.Discount is a fraction from 0 to 0.30 (0.10 = 10% off), not a percentage.
"Customers from X" filters Customers.State (where the customer lives). "Orders shipped to X" filters Orders.ShipState (delivery destination). About 10% of orders ship to a different state.

Customers link to Employees in two different ways: Customers.AccountManagerID is the customer's assigned account manager (business customers only); Orders.EmployeeID is the sales rep who booked a particular order (NULL for self-service online consumer orders). Pick the one the question means.
Current employees have Status IN ('Active', 'On Leave'). Former employees keep their row with Status 'Terminated' and a TerminationDate.
Some customers have never ordered and some products have never sold. Use LEFT JOIN when the question asks to include them, or NOT EXISTS / LEFT JOIN ... IS NULL to find them.
Products.IsDiscontinued is an INTEGER flag (1 = discontinued, 0 = still sold).

Employees.description: Everyone who works or has worked at Summit Supply Co., including the org chart.
Employees.grain: One row per employee (former employees are kept with Status 'Terminated').

values.meaning: Sales reps, account executives and sales management.
Software, data, QA and DevOps engineers.

ManagerID.description: EmployeeID of the employee's direct manager; NULL only for the CEO.

TerminationDate.description: Last day of employment; NULL for current employees.

Salary.description: Annual base salary in USD (pro-rated for part-time staff).

values.meaning: No longer with the company (see TerminationDate).

City.description: City the employee works from (office city, or home city for remote staff).

State.description: 2-letter USPS code of the state the employee works from.

Customers.description: People and businesses who have an account with Summit Supply Co.

FirstName.description: First name of the customer (or the business's main contact).

LastName.description: Last name of the customer (or the business's main contact).

CompanyName.description: Business name for Small Business and Corporate customers; NULL for consumers.

Phone.description: Contact phone number; NULL when the customer did not provide one.

State.description: 2-letter USPS code of the state the customer lives in.

PostalCode.description: ZIP code of the customer's address.

values.meaning: Individual shopper buying for personal use.
Large company account, usually with an account manager and bank-transfer terms.

LoyaltyTier.description: Loyalty tier based on lifetime spend on delivered orders.

values.meaning: Lifetime delivered spend under $1,000 (includes customers who never ordered).
Lifetime delivered spend from $1,000 to under $5,000.
Lifetime delivered spend from $5,000 to under $25,000.
Lifetime delivered spend of $25,000 or more.

SignupDate.description: Date the customer created their account.

AccountManagerID.description: Employee assigned as the customer's account manager (Small Business and Corporate customers only; NULL for consumers).

SKU.description: Stock-keeping unit code (unique), prefixed by a category code.

values.meaning: Laptops, monitors, tablets and computer peripherals.
Health devices and personal care products.

UnitPrice.description: Current list price in USD (what it would sell for today, before discounts).

UnitCost.description: Current unit cost to Summit Supply in USD (used for profit and inventory value).

ReorderLevel.description: Stock level at or below which the product should be reordered.

IsDiscontinued.description: 1 if the product is no longer sold, 0 if it is still sold.

LaunchDate.description: Date the product was first available for sale.

Orders.description: Customer orders (one header row per order), including payment and fulfilment status.
Orders.grain: One row per order. Line items are in OrderItems.

CustomerID.description: The customer who placed the order.

EmployeeID.description: The employee (sales rep) who booked the order; NULL for self-service online orders from consumers.

Status.description: Fulfilment status of the order as of the snapshot date.

values.meaning: Delivered and then sent back; the payment was refunded.
Handed to the carrier, not yet delivered.
Placed but not yet being processed.

Channel.description: Sales channel the order came through.

values.meaning: Placed by phone with a rep.
Placed through a reseller or marketplace partner.
Bought in a physical store (collected immediately).

PaymentMethod.description: How the order was paid for.

values.meaning: Invoice paid by bank transfer on net terms (mostly business customers).
Apple Pay / Google Pay style mobile wallet.

PaymentStatus.description: Payment state of the order as of the snapshot date.

values.meaning: Payment was returned to the customer.
Order cancelled before any payment was captured.
Payment not yet received (open invoice or awaiting capture).

ShippingCost.description: Shipping fee charged to the customer in USD (0 for free shipping or in-store).

ShippedDate.description: Date the order left the warehouse; NULL if not shipped yet or cancelled.

DeliveredDate.description: Date the order was delivered; NULL if not delivered (yet).

ShipState.description: 2-letter USPS code of the delivery destination state.

OrderItems.description: Order lines — which products were bought in each order, how many, and at what price.
OrderItems.grain: One row per product per order.

OrderID.description: The order this line belongs to.

ProductID.description: The product bought on this line.

UnitPrice.description: Price per unit charged at the time of sale, before the line discount (USD).

Discount.description: Discount on this line as a fraction (0.10 = 10% off).
